positions.title: Summer Reasearcher
positions.description:
Study of the beta spectrometer for the aCORN experiment in nuclear physics.
Included writing analysis code, acquisition of data, and analysis of the data. Collaborated with mentor on the meaning of data and how to proceed in analysis. Presented findings in a talk at the end of the internship.
